messages.text:
Help me choose: explain the remaining questions in plain language. Keep my original task and the details I already provided.
My answers so far:
Product name: Vector Business
Customer benefit and description: A shared AI workspace for product teams. Includes 20 seats, unlimited projects, 50,000 monthly AI credits, team analytics, and priority support.
Price: 129
Currency: USD

Choose billing and trial terms
Monthly billing lowers the upfront commitment; yearly billing offers a longer commitment and fewer renewals. A free trial delays the first charge, a paid trial charges a reduced amount during evaluation, and no trial charges the full $129 when the subscription begins.
Billing period Choices: Monthly; Yearly.
Trial choice Choices: No trial; Free trial; Paid trial.

clarification.title: Choose billing and trial terms
clarification.description: Monthly billing lowers the upfront commitment; yearly billing offers a longer commitment and fewer renewals. A free trial delays the first charge, a paid trial charges a reduced amount during evaluation, and no trial charges the full $129 when the subscription begins.

questions.label: Billing period
questions.description: Should customers pay $129 each month or each year?

questions.label: Trial choice
questions.description: Choose whether customers can evaluate the plan before regular billing.

options.label: Free trial
options.description: No charge during the trial; requires a trial length in days.

options.label: Paid trial
options.description: Charge a reduced trial amount; requires a trial length and price.
